entries.back_en: "The curse the Empire makes is like a black mist... And there's all sorts of bad stuff in it—hauntings, specters... Even the smallest exposure to it without protection is lethal!"
entries.note: Sentido preservado; 'névoa' está sem acento (nevoa), erro menor.

entries.back_en: "We need to cross Chamba. Is there any way we can do that before the curse disappears?"
"Come to think of it... You weren't with us when we cleaned up Synesta, were you?"
